---
title: Mustard Pear Sauce
id: MAR-0066
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 40
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 500 g pears
- 200 g sugar
- 2 tablespoons Dijon mustard
## Method
1. Wash the pears, peel them and cut them into wedges, removing the core and stem.
2. Place them in a large bowl, sprinkle with the sugar, mix and let rest for 12 hours.
3. Transfer the mixture to a saucepan, add 2 dl of water and cook for 30 minutes, until the fruit has broken down; stir and turn off the heat.
4. Add the mustard, mix again, let cool and serve.
5. Excellent for accompanying cheeses and meats.
